description: Read only. The traceability gaps of a model, for a human to review: requirements no satisfy statement covers, satisfied requirements with no check (so no verdict is possible) or no verification case, requirement definitions nothing satisfies, satisfy statements whose part is not in the system, and top level subsystems no requirement names as its subject. Changes nothing. Output: { checked, summary, unsatisfied_requirements, requirements_without_check, requirements_without_verification, requirement_definitions_not_satisfied, subsystems_without_requirements }.

root.description: The top level part usage to elaborate (default: the last one, the configured system).

text.description: The complete SysML v2 model text. The server keeps no state: pass the whole current text on every call, and after an edit use the text the edit returned.

name: trace_gaps
title: Find traceability gaps
